name: Collectr
subtitle: Turn moments into numbered collector cards
localizedDescription: Create gently rounded photo cards with on-device Depth Anything 3, subtle motion and clear protective sleeves. Set a fixed edition size and rarity, collect numbered copies and transfer them between nearby phones. Includes native Liquid Glass and photo-matched ambient colors. Sealing requires confirmation to remove the original from Photos. Nearby edition records are local, without a global scarcity server. Physical iPhone motion and two-phone trading still need device testing.
